latestNews.details: Texier (lower-body) is healthy and able to return vs. Florida on Tuesday.

latestNews.details: Newhook (fractured ankle) will return to Montreal's lineup on Thursday vs. the Islanders.
latestNews.fantasyDetails: Newhook has been sidelined since mid-November due to a fractured ankle, but is set to return to Montreal's lineup in their first game back from the Olympic break on Thursday against the New York Islanders. The 25-year-old Newhook is averaging 14:38 time-on-ice and has 12 points (6G / 6A) in 17 games this season.

latestNews.details: Dach (upper-body) is healthy and able to return vs. Florida on Tuesday.

latestNews.details: Anderson (rest) is not expected to play on Tuesday.

latestNews.details: Matheson (rest) is not expected to play on Tuesday.
latestNews.fantasyDetails: With nothing left to decide for the Canadiens in the 2025-26 season apart from who will have home-ice advantage in their opening-round playoff matchup against the Tampa Bay Lightning, the team will opt to rest some players in the final game of the regular season.
